news.title: Bengaluru's BDA apartments yet to fully turn EV infrastructure switch on
news.para: In Bengaluru, the trend of electric vehicle ownership is gaining momentum in apartment communities. A recent survey indicates that merely one in fifteen BDA complexes boasts a communal charging unit. The majority of residents rely on public charging stations or set up home solutions remotely. Notably, there's a strong enthusiasm among potential buyers for EVs in the coming years.

news.title: Set up dedicated sub-registrar office at PMC headquarters: Builders’ association urges Pune civic body
news.para: The Marathi Bandhkam Vyavsayik Association has formally approached the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) to establish a dedicated property registration office. According to Nitin Deshpande, the association's president, this development promises to streamline the property registration process, benefiting both builders and citizens. PMC is currently reviewing this proposal and will determine its viability while also coordinating with the Registration and Stamps Department for further insights.

news.title: Ease plan approvals for 70 metres buildings, says CREDAI-Ahmedabad
news.para: CREDAI Ahmedabad has urged the state government to streamline the approval process for highrise projects. The association highlighted delays in project timelines due to issues with Transferable Development Rights availability. They proposed a staged approval system separating plan scrutiny from TDR loading requirements. Developers requested that punitive actions not target builders for unrelated traffic issues caused by parking violations.

news.title: Branded PGs & guesthouses set up at homes in Gurugram's Sushant Lok-3 on government radar, 30 served notices
news.para: In Sushant Lok-3, over 30 structures have been flagged for potential enforcement measures due to the operation of unauthorized PGs, guest houses, and commercial activities within residential areas. Local residents are expressing their grievances, particularly about issues related to parking, drainage, and the strain on utilities stemming from these illicit operations.

news.title: Ahmedabad: Co-operative board stays society’s ban on renting flats to bachelors
news.para: A ruling by the Board of Nominees in Ahmedabad highlighted conflicts between housing society rules and individual property rights. Deepika Dhadhal challenged a society resolution that prohibited renting flats to bachelors and unmarried individuals. The society's meeting resulted in warnings against Dhadhal for her compliance with the imposed restrictions. The Board noted the society's violations of its own bye-laws during the proceedings.

news.title: Cement capacity set to outpace demand through FY29
news.para: With a surge in expected cement industry capacity, a notable supply-demand imbalance looms on the horizon. Growth in production will likely align closely with consumption patterns, though substantial enhancements in capacity utilization seem unlikely. Leading firms like UltraTech Cement and Ambuja Cements are gearing up for this anticipated demand surge.

news.title: Pune: SC orders status quo on NGT demolition order against 20 Chikhali bungalows in blueline area
news.para: The Supreme Court has offered temporary reprieve by ordering a halt to the demolition of buildings in Chikhali. This move follows an NGT directive demanding the identification of structures located within the floodline for potential demolition. Residents in Moi Phata have challenged the legality of 20 structures, claiming valid permissions with the PCMC.

news.title: YEIDA approves logistics park, 8,000 hectares industrial hub near Noida International airport
news.para: The development of Noida International Airport is gearing up for a substantial boost with plans for a state-of-the-art multimodal logistics park. The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority has sanctioned key projects to improve the area's infrastructure, paving the way for an 8,000-hectare industrial hub intended to catalyze industrial expansion and lure investments.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh fixes 112-day deadline for land use change, cuts conversion fee
news.para: Local development authorities in Uttar Pradesh have unveiled an efficient timeline for processing land-use conversion requests for smaller plots, setting a duration of 112 days. The technical review will be wrapped up in 22 days, with property owners given 60 days to provide feedback. Furthermore, a six-member committee will assess land changes and objections in a month.

news.title: Noida: Logix, 3C & ATS submit revised layouts for Sports City
news.para: The Noida Authority is reigniting interest in the long-awaited Sports City projects as developers submit new layout plans. Major players like Logix Infra Developers, 3C Green Construction, and ATS Homes are involved. The Authority is now collecting public feedback for the next 15 days. A recent Supreme Court ruling opens doors for about 20,000 homebuyers. Developers promise to finalize sporting facilities in three years and residences within five.

news.title: Builders face action for ignoring mandatory green approvals in Andhra Pradesh
news.para: Recent developments in Andhra Pradesh reveal that several large construction initiatives are kicking off sans the much-needed environmental clearances. In response, the Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board is intensifying its inspection efforts and penalizing non-compliant builders. Developers must obtain a Consent to Establish before embarking on any construction. Prospective property buyers should ensure all necessary environmental permits are in place to avoid dealing with potential legal troubles.

news.title: Delhi civic body launches property tax amnesty scheme 'SUNIYO 2.0'
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has introduced a property tax amnesty scheme for taxpayers. This scheme enables clearing current and past dues without penalties until December 31. Taxpayers can pay principal dues for the fiscal years from 2019-20 to 2026-27 without additional costs. An instalment facility is also available for those with a liability of Rs 5 lakh or more.

news.title: DDA launches digital map for areas planned under Master Plan for Delhi 2047
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority has unveiled a GIS-powered interactive digital map, revolutionizing how citizens interact with the Land Use Plan. With this tool, residents can conveniently retrieve land-use data regarding properties from the comfort of their homes, eliminating the need for local office visits. The map, illustrated with distinct color codes for clarity, will be regularly upgraded to keep pace with Delhi's dynamic planning landscape.

news.title: JSW Cement approves merger of Shiva Cement; sets 5:41 share-swap ratio
news.para: JSW Cement’s board has approved the merger of its 66.23%-owned subsidiary Shiva Cement with the company. Shiva Cement’s public shareholders will receive five JSW Cement shares for every 41 shares held, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.

news.title: Runwal Enterprises IPO subscribed 2.5 times on final day
news.para: On its final day, Runwal Enterprises Ltd's IPO was met with significant enthusiasm, achieving a subscription level of 2.5 times. Notable demand came from non-institutional investors and Qualified Institutional Buyers, indicating robust market interest. Priced between Rs 290 and Rs 305 per equity share, the proceeds will support debt repayment and ambitious development plans across its affordable, mid-income, and luxury residential divisions.

news.title: Brookfield India REIT, NCW acquire three floors in Godrej BKC, Mumbai
news.para: Brookfield India REIT and NCW’s Prime Offices Fund have completed the acquisition of Parthos Properties through a 50:50 joint venture. Parthos owns and operates the second, third and fourth floors of Godrej BKC in Mumbai.

news.title: CPP Investments to invest ₹3,000 crore in Prestige Hospitality Ventures for 27% stake
news.para: CPP Investments will invest up to ₹3,000 crore in Prestige Hospitality Ventures through a mix of primary capital infusion and secondary share purchase. Prestige Estates will receive ₹950 crore from the stake sale, while ₹2,050 crore will be infused into the hospitality subsidiary.

news.title: TVS Motor Company leases five lakh sq ft office in Bengaluru for 10 years
news.para: TVS Motor Company has secured a long-term lease for over 500,000 sq ft of office space in Bengaluru. The lease will span more than ten years and aims to consolidate existing operations. This transaction reflects the growing trend among companies seeking larger office spaces. Bengaluru's office market continues to thrive, with demand extending beyond traditional business districts.

news.title: Spain aims to ban evictions until 2030 amid housing protests
news.para: The Spanish government on Tuesday approved measures including a ban on evictions until 2030 and the automatic renewal of tenant contracts, a minister said, following days of nationwide housing protests. Health Minister Monica Garcia listed on social media a series of measures including the eviction ban and the automatic contract renewals, saying what had been achieved was "unimaginable a month ago".

news.title: Panchkula civic body issues final warning to 100 property tax defaulters
news.para: In a decisive move, the Panchkula municipal corporation has issued final notifications to 100 individuals with outstanding property taxes totaling approximately Rs 10 crore. These defaulters must attend a hearing on October 5 to sidestep property confiscation. The municipality is also pursuing tax recovery from governmental offices and will publish an updated defaulter roster post the August 31 payment deadline.
